name: bu_Mg4Cu8
title: MgCu2 (Mg4Cu8) Laves-phase crystal
description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of the Laves phase MgCu2 with four formula units (12 atoms) per cell: a size-mismatched, topologically close-packed intermetallic. Experimental ground state: cubic C15 (Fd-3m); the hexagonal C14 (MgZn2-type) polytype and AlB2/MoSi2-type AB2 structures compete. NEP89 reproduces C15 as the global minimum, but C14 is only 0.5 meV/atom higher (within e_tol, so it also counts as a hit).
